Use the View button to open the label in a new tab for immediate printing, or Download to save it locally.

The Classic card is designed for 40mm x 30mm labels . Vertical versions (30×40mm and 25×40mm) are also available. Recommended printers are .

Labels are designed for the swatches you can print from this model: . You can also find mounts for your storage and AMS units on the same page.

There are two file formats for the  and other simple image formats:

Labelife Image - uses the above generated image for the whole label (better for matching what is shown here)
Labelife Native - uses native Labelife controls for manual editing of the label. This version has some cross-platform compatibility issues.
PNG Image - a simple image of the label in PNG format
SVG Image - a simple image of the label in SVG format
PDF - a PDF file containing just the label
Printing this page using your browser's print function also prints the swatch card for any apps that only take PDF files
